title: Cloncurry Post Office

terrainReference.basis: Public source elevation near the street-facing steps.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap office way 462782527, office node 1916584568 and Queensland Heritage Register entry 600416.
mapIdentity.scope: The four native corners of the present-day named office control the frontage and site envelope. The circa-1910 photo and Queensland register description establish the projecting central gable and raised twin porches. The original rear wall position is estimated.

note: The 1910 photograph shows timber siding, slatted gable, shuttered central window, low timber steps and corrugated hip roof. The front is partly obscured by the carriage and a tear in the archival print. The register confirms the standard T17 layout.
